title: Charles VI to Count Leopold Viktorin Windischgrätz, 1720-22 (DECODE R5021-R5024), the Emperor's private key R5018

documents.shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, RA Windischgrätz inv. 694 karton 5 (autograph, DECODE R5021); inv. 5 book 5 pp. 404-407 (copy, DECODE R5022)

transcription.notes: Counts for Nos. 2, 3, 6 are a script count of the numbers, [sign] and two-letter code tokens in the bold cipher strings of dec_R5018_letters.md, not a --measure result; there is no separate ciphertext file.

documents.shelfmark: SOA Plzeň, RA Windischgrätz inv. 5 book 5 pp. 407-409 (copy, DECODE R5023; autograph not found)
SOA Plzeň, RA Windischgrätz inv. 5 book 5 pp. 414-416 (copy, DECODE R5024)

system.summary: The Emperor's private key R5018: each of 24 letters a number from 10 to 38 and a graphic sign, the vowels a second number; about 300 codes (39-210 and two-letter groups) for words and names; nulls 3-7 and 9.
system.sibling_key: Not applicable: the key (R5018) survives in the same family archive and was used directly.
system.notes: The copyist's signs drift (the q-with-crossbars sign serves D and once N; p with one crossbar serves Z and G), settled by the numbered letters around them. The 3 Feb 1720 letter in the Chancellery key R5017 announced this key (windischgraetz1720).

prior_solution.where: Mírka, Západočeské archivy 2012 (repr. Crypto-World 3-4/2013) describes the letters and keys but prints no decryption; none found by web search 19 Sept 2026

conditions.human_role: Supplied the DECODE login (session cookie) for images and key records.

solution.what: Fetched DECODE R5017-R5024 images and record pages; the letter records point to keys R5017 and R5018.
Mírka 2012 found: describes the private key and the Reichshofrat nomenclator, prints no decryption; web search found none.
Transcribed R5018 (24-letter grid of numbers and signs, ~300 codes, nulls).
Nos. 2, 3, 6 read with R5018 letter by letter; drifting copyist signs settled by the surrounding numbered letters.
All 35 passages read as German fitting the clear context and the 1720-22 diplomacy (Alberoni's fall, Beretti Landi marriage proposal).

Entry split from windischgraetz1720 under the one-key rule (Lasry, 14 Oct 2026): Nos. 2, 3, 6 are in the private key R5018, not the Chancellery key R5017 of No. 1. Fraction measured on these three: 192/192.

outcome.method_basis: The DECODE letter records point to the Emperor's private key R5018, which Mirka (2012) had described; the project transcribed it and applied it directly to Nos. 2, 3 and 6, settling the copyist's drifting signs from the surrounding numbered letters.
outcome.fraction_read_source: dec_R5018_letters.md: 192 cipher tokens of Nos. 2, 3, 6 (37 + 88 + 67); signs marked ? but read in context counted read.
outcome.notes: The key survives and was applied directly; no cryptanalysis. Nos. 4, 5 and 7 of the register are not on DECODE and have no document entry. The clear text is only summarised around the cipher passages. Split on 14 Oct 2026 from windischgraetz1720.
